$comment: 精选插件列表 — dsh-plugins-plugin 在插件页自动拉取本文件展示。直接编辑提交即可,无需接入任何插件。entries 字段: package(npm 包名,必填) / title(必填) / description / version / icon(URL) / homepage / tags(≤8)。 只需填 package 与 title,提交后跑 node scripts/enrich.mjs 自动补齐版本号、stars、月下载量、英文简介、分类、截图; 版本号之后由日更 Actions 与 publish_npm.sh 自动对齐 npm latest,不用手改。

entries.title: TokenBank免费模型
entries.description: 一键注册 TokenBank 领免费 API Key($5 体验金),免费 GLM 模型直接进模型列表;自带余额查询与密钥托管。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Free TokenBank GLM models in one click: register for a free API key with a $5 credit, models go straight into the model list with protocol and capabilities auto-configured; balance, daily check-in, key deposits (temporary quota to permanent balance, upstream probe) and CNY recharge via Alipay. No self-hosted relay needed.

entries.title: 远程控制
entries.description: 通过 8 位数字码从任何设备远程访问你的 DSH 主机,支持公网中转部署。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Reach any DeepSeek Harness host by its 8-digit code through a relay origin: a browser-surface remote control with relay-prefixed GUI passthrough, per-host WebSocket muxing, a visitor fetch/WebSocket shim that rewrites same-origin calls, owner-only HTTP APIs, and optional concealment of the code in the URL via an origin-level Service Worker. Off by default; it must be enabled from the owner panel in the sidebar. Once enabled, it connects out to the author's relay dsh.skillpie.cn, and whoever holds the code gets full control of the GUI on this machine.

entries.title: 技能市场
entries.description: 在 DSH 内搜索并安装 Agent 技能的市场插件。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Skill marketplace in the DSH sidebar: browse and search the SkillPie skill library, install agent skills into ~/.agents/skills with one click so new sessions can use them, plus a same-origin search/detail/install/installed API that conversation tools can reuse.

entries.title: SkillPie邮箱
entries.description: 管理 @skillpie.cn 邮箱:快速注册/添加/移除,后台 IMAP 轮询,新邮件全局弹窗提醒。
entries.author: skillpie

entries.title: 数据源
entries.description: 在 DSH 内连接 MySQL/PostgreSQL 等数据库,直接查询与编辑数据。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Connect SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL databases in DeepSeek Harness: browse table structure and data, run SQL, and let the assistant query and edit data directly in the conversation.

entries.title: 代码版本管理
entries.description: Git 工作台:changelist、暂存、历史、分支一站式管理。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: session-header chips keep branch, change count and sync state at hand for in-place switching, review and pull/push; the full window adds a lane commit graph, block-level staging, interactive rebase and history rewrite with restore points, batch cherry-pick, a three-way conflict editor, inline blame, worktree management and Git LFS import/export.

entries.title: 网页工具箱
entries.description: 右侧栏浏览器工具箱:元素拾取器 + 自由尺寸视口。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Element picker and free-size viewport for the right-sidebar browser: hover-highlight a page element to send its selector, styles and HTML snippet into the chat draft, and resize the webview to remembered device presets with auto-fit scaling.

entries.title: 终端栏
entries.description: 在 Web GUI 右上角工具区添加终端开关,点按打开/关闭底部终端面板。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Terminal panel toggle for the DSH web GUI: a header button that opens and closes a bottom terminal panel backed by a PTY engine over the subprocess service, with a same-origin control API, WebSocket I/O, session list and scrollback.

entries.title: 项目汇报
entries.description: 按 Git 提交历史生成项目日报,支持手动与定时,可提交 Moka 加班。
entries.author: skillpie
entries.descriptionEn: Project reporting in the DSH sidebar: draft a per-project report from its git commits and session records with one click, run it on a built-in schedule with a configurable daily cutover offset, and optionally submit Moka overtime automatically; all sessions of a project share one report.

entries.title: 百万上下文
entries.description: 上下文压缩插件:小窗口(100K 上下文足矣)也能跑长任务,省 5 倍 token,支持数月级几十亿 token 的单会话。
entries.author: ranxianglei
entries.descriptionEn: The official billion-context plugin: a context-compression plugin for small context windows (a 100K context is enough), token savings (5x fewer tokens), and month-long single sessions (billions of tokens).
